offering_description.value: Cultivates, processes and sells cannabis products through its own retail dispensaries, online ordering and wholesale sales. Serves adult-use and medical cannabis consumers and patients in licensed US states, making most products in-house.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; vape cartridges; edibles; concentrates; tinctures

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult-use and medical cannabis consumers and patients buying in dispensaries and online; B2B: licensed cannabis dispensaries buying wholesale products

end_markets.value: cannabis retail; medical cannabis; consumer packaged goods

revenue_model.value: product sales: cannabis products sold to consumers at dispensaries and online, and wholesale to other dispensaries

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: cultivates and processes cannabis into finished products sold to retail and wholesale customers; brand owner: sells its own branded cannabis products through its own channels; distributor: wholesales products to other licensed dispensaries; retailer: operates dispensaries selling cannabis products directly to consumers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; distributor; retailer

geography_served.value: US national: licensed cannabis markets across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: flower, vapes, edibles, concentrates and tinctures sharing cannabis cultivation, processing and retail

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned retail dispensaries; online: online ordering for pickup and delivery; direct sales: wholesale sales to other licensed dispensaries

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state cannabis licenses needed to cultivate, process and sell, overseen by state cannabis regulators, federal law still prohibits cannabis

notes: Cannabis federal legal status and state footprint may change, so details could be out of date.
